Notes for agents

Source: AGENTS.md

NEWS.md

Every user-visible change gets a NEWS.md bullet in the same PR. Skip tests, CI, version bumps and other housekeeping.

  • Collect all unreleased changes under the top heading, # epidatr (development version). Don’t add a heading per patch version: the version-bump workflow raises DESCRIPTION after every merge into dev, but those are development versions, not releases (the CRAN version is the latest release; see “Versioning” in DEVELOPMENT.md).
  • At release time the maintainer renames that heading to the release version (the “polish NEWS” step in DEVELOPMENT.md). Don’t do it in a feature PR.
  • Use the sections Breaking changes, Changes, Documentation and Patches, and cite the issue or PR number when there is one.

To check that NEWS is complete, compare the log since the last release tag (git tag / jj tag list) against the bullets.
